pub_median_null_probability.source: my arithmetic: under the same no-difference assumption, the candidate's median is below the champion's median with probability 1/2 (symmetry)

pub_disjoint_null_probability_20v20.source: my arithmetic: if candidate and champion samples are 20 i.i.d. draws each from one continuous distribution, every ordering of the 40 values is equally likely, so P(all 20 candidate values below all 20 champion values) = 1 / C(40,20) = 1 / 137 846 528 820
